objective: Evaluate Phase 2A.7 filing-event profiles against future stock returns at fixed 21, 63, and 126 trading-session horizons using only locally available official/NSE/BSE-tagged market history.
price_source_policy: Accept only local structured price files whose path is explicitly tagged official, NSE, BSE, or exchange.
Reject any path or provider metadata containing yfinance or fallback-yfinance.
Do not access the network in this bundled run.
Record accepted and rejected files plus duplicate/conflict diagnostics.
return_policy: Entry is the first available trading-session close strictly after the filing availability calendar date.
Forward N-session return uses entry close to close N trading sessions later.
If N later sessions are unavailable, mark that horizon immature instead of extrapolating.
Do not use same-day close even when a filing timestamp is earlier than market close; this is deliberately conservative.
mixed_policy: Retain MIXED_DIRECTIONAL outcomes for audit but exclude them from the primary deterioration-versus-improvement effect.
forbidden: No model fitting or threshold tuning.
